after.zh: 输出不再只看自己，而是看邻居的加权和。这就是滤波。
after.en: The output no longer looks only at its own pixel, but at a weighted sum of its neighbours. This is filtering.

t.zh: 到目前为止，输出的每一格只看输入里同一位置的那一格。这一章换个思路：算一格时，也看看它周围的邻居。
t.en: So far, each output cell has looked only at the cell in the same position in the input. This chapter changes that: when computing a cell, also look at the neighbours around it.

t.zh: 最简单的例子是取平均。把一格换成它和邻居的平均，孤零零的亮点会被摊开，忽亮忽暗的毛刺会被抹平。手机夜景模式压噪点，用的就是同类的办法。
t.en: The simplest example is averaging. Replace a cell with the average of itself and its neighbours, and a lone bright dot gets spread out while flickering specks get smoothed away. A phone's night mode uses the same kind of trick to suppress noise.

t.zh: 从这一章起，相加、相减、相乘合成一个元件<part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>：在元件上选 +、−、× 或 ÷。÷ 是新的：a ÷ b 把 a 的每一格除以 b 的同一格。还有一个新元件<part-ref to="part:merge"></part-ref>：它有三个输入口，把接进来的图逐格加起来，空着的口不算。
t.en: From this chapter on, add, subtract and multiply are one part, <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>: choose +, −, × or ÷ on the part. ÷ is new: a ÷ b divides each cell of a by the same cell of b. There is also a new part, the <part-ref to="part:merge"></part-ref>: it has three inputs and adds the pictures wired into them cell by cell; an empty input is skipped.

t.zh: 新画法「剖面」：把图上一行的亮度画成一条曲线，在图上拖动就换一行。元件和测试区的画法按钮里都能切到它。
t.en: A new way of drawing, "Profile": the brightness along one row of the picture as a curve; drag on the picture to change row. Switch to it with the drawing buttons on a part or in the test area.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每一格换成它自己和左右两个邻居的平均。看看下面的期望：方块左右两条边多出一圈灰，上下两条边却没变。
t.en: Your task in this level: replace each cell with the average of itself and its left and right neighbours. Look at the expected output below: the square's left and right edges gain a band of grey, but its top and bottom edges do not change.

brief.zh: 每个像素换成它和左右两个邻居的平均。
brief.en: Replace each pixel with the average of itself and its left and right neighbours.

hint.zh: 你需要「往左挪一格」的图、「往右挪一格」的图和原图。
hint.en: You need the image shifted one pixel left, the image shifted one pixel right, and the original.
